inputs.plan:
PLAN:
1. Add structured JSON request logging middleware to the dashboard HTTP server (new file)
2. Log method, path, status, duration for each request
inputs.conventions: Zero external Go dependencies - stdlib only (net/http, encoding/json, log/slog). No web frameworks.

assertions.value:
Check the design output against these criteria:
1. Proposes an HTTP middleware pattern using only net/http (http.Handler or http.HandlerFunc wrapping)
2. Captures all four fields: HTTP method, request path, response status code, and request duration
3. Uses log/slog or encoding/json for structured logging (not fmt.Println or log.Printf)
4. Does NOT reference any third-party web framework (gin, chi, echo, mux, fiber, etc.)
